criteria.name: Research Question
criteria.description: States a focused question the poster sets out to answer.

ratings.description: The question is stated in one sentence near the top, names a specific population or system, and is narrow enough to answer with the data shown.
The question is stated and specific, but it is broader than the data shown can fully answer.
A topic is named, but it is phrased as a subject area rather than a question, or the reader has to infer the question.
No question can be identified; the poster describes a topic without saying what it investigates.

criteria.name: Use of Evidence
criteria.description: Supports each claim with data or cited sources.

ratings.description: Every claim is backed by data shown on the poster or a cited source, and each figure is referenced in the text that interprets it.
Most claims are backed by data or citations; one or two claims rely on assertion alone.
Data or citations appear, but several claims are not connected to them, or figures are shown without interpretation.
Claims are made without data or citations, or the data shown does not relate to the claims.

criteria.name: Visual Organization
criteria.description: Arranges content so a viewer can follow it in a logical order.

ratings.description: Sections follow a clear reading path (question, method, results, conclusion) with headings, and every figure has a caption and labeled axes.
Sections follow a reading path with headings; one or two figures lack captions or axis labels.
Headings exist, but the reading order is unclear, or several figures lack captions or labels.
No headings or reading path; text and figures are placed without an order the viewer can follow.

criteria.name: Citations
criteria.description: Credits sources in a consistent citation style.

ratings.description: All sources are cited in one consistent style, and every in-text citation matches an entry in the reference list.
All sources are cited; there are minor style inconsistencies or one mismatched reference.
Some sources are cited, but the style is inconsistent or several in-text citations have no matching reference.
Sources are used but not cited, or citations cannot be matched to any reference.
